manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
easyPrerequisites: Silverskin Armor attached to Medomai the Ageless.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.
